front.title: An Audit Record Format for AI Agent Authorization Decisions

abstract.t: This document defines a record format for AI agent authorization decisions. The format is one in-toto predicate type, signed inside a DSSE envelope. It carries the seven minimum audit fields that the WIMSE AI Identity Management System framework requires, and two properties that make those fields checkable: a canonicalization contract, and both the authorization decision and the observed effect with a derived three-valued agreement between them. That framework places the record format out of scope and takes no IANA action. This document supplies the format. It defines no policy.
